'''Gelgelar''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|cold]], [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]]-covered [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Glarsaur]]s.

==History==
[[File:Gelgelar_Free_Port.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]]]]
Near constant precipitation and cloudy weather put the world in a unabated gloom and encouraged the growth of mold and moss. It was colonized by a motley group offworlders in [[250 BBY/Legends|250 BBY]], mainly criminals, political prisoners on the lam and transients.<ref name="PSG" /> It had a [[Shrine of Kooroo]]. The principal exports were [[shvash gas]] and [[vohis mold]]. [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]] was the only [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] and city.

The planet was in the same system as the site of the [[Evacuation of Gelgelar]] and a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hospital base in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. While the planet and system was a decided backwater in the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was dubious enough that it escaped [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attention after the arrival of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wooyou Senn]]'s fleet.
